twoWayTables.name: Two-way tables: rows, columns and totals
twoWayTables.rule: A two-way table shows data for two features at once: one feature in the rows and one in the columns. Row totals, column totals and the grand total give the number of people in each category and in the whole group.
examples: 40 students are asked how they travel to school. Girls: 9 walk and 13 take the bus. Boys: 7 walk and 11 take the bus. For a student picked at random, P(walks) = (9 + 7) ÷ 40 = 16/40 = 2/5. If the student picked is a girl, P(walks) = 9/22.

contrast.en: The denominator is the total of the group named in the question. For a girl, use the 22 girls, not the 40 students.
contrast.ru: Знаменатель — это итог той группы, о которой спрашивают. Для девочки берём 22 девочки, а не 40 учеников.

sources.title: РЭШ · Сбор и группировка статистических данных
sources.section: Сбор и группировка статистических данных: таблицы

rangeSpread.name: Range as a measure of spread
rangeSpread.rule: The range measures spread: how far apart the values are. Range = largest value − smallest value. A range of 0 means all values are equal, and one extreme value can change the range a lot.
examples: Class A marks: 52, 58, 61, 70. Class B marks: 45, 60, 75. Range A = 70 − 52 = 18 and range B = 75 − 45 = 30, so the marks of class B are more spread out.

contrast.en: The range is a difference, not one of the values: 25 is not the range of the first data set.
contrast.ru: Размах — это разность, а не одно из значений: число 25 в первом наборе — не размах.

mutuallyExclusive.name: Mutually exclusive events: events that cannot happen together
mutuallyExclusive.rule: Two events are mutually exclusive if they cannot both happen in a single trial. Their sets have no outcome in common, so A ∩ B = ∅ and P(A and B) = 0.
examples: A fair six-sided die is rolled once. A = odd number = {1, 3, 5} and B = even number = {2, 4, 6} have no outcome in common, so they are mutually exclusive. C = number greater than 4 = {5, 6} shares the outcome 6 with B, so B and C are not mutually exclusive.

contrast.en: Mutually exclusive does not mean unrelated. If A happens, B cannot happen.
contrast.ru: Несовместные — не значит «никак не связанные»: если наступило A, событие B уже не может наступить.

addProbabilities.name: Adding probabilities of mutually exclusive events
addProbabilities.rule: If events A and B are mutually exclusive, P(A or B) = P(A) + P(B): the probabilities are added. This is the addition rule, and it works for any number of mutually exclusive events.
examples: A card is taken at random from a pack of 52. P(heart) = 13/52 and P(spade) = 13/52. A card cannot be both a heart and a spade, so P(heart or spade) = 13/52 + 13/52 = 26/52 = 1/2.

contrast.en: Only events that cannot happen together can be added. A heart and a king can both happen (the king of hearts), so P(heart or king) is not 13/52 + 4/52.
contrast.ru: Складывать можно только события, которые не могут произойти вместе. Карта может быть одновременно червой и королём (король червей), поэтому P(червы или король) не равно 13/52 + 4/52.

sources.title: Oxford · MYP Mathematics 4&5 Standard (2021)
sources.section: §4.2 · Probability of single and combined events, pp. 234–259

sampling.name: Sampling: simple random, systematic and stratified samples
sampling.rule: A sample is part of a population. Each method below needs a sampling frame: a list of every member of the population. Simple random sampling gives every member an equal chance. Systematic sampling takes every nth member of an ordered list after a random start. Stratified sampling splits the population into groups and samples each group in proportion to its size. A larger sample usually gives more reliable results.
examples: A school has 300 students: 180 in Year 10 and 120 in Year 11. A stratified sample of 30 keeps the proportions: Year 10 gets 30 × 180/300 = 18 students and Year 11 gets 30 × 120/300 = 12 students.
From a list of 300 students, start at a random student among the first 10 and take every 10th student: this gives a systematic sample of 300 ÷ 10 = 30 students.

contrast.en: A large sample is not automatically fair. A biased method gives a biased sample, however many people it includes.
contrast.ru: Большая выборка не гарантирует отсутствия смещения. Если способ отбора смещён, выборка будет смещённой, сколько бы людей в неё ни вошло.

sources.section: Сбор и группировка статистических данных: выборка

correlation.name: Correlation and the line of best fit
correlation.rule: Correlation describes how closely the points of a scatter diagram follow a straight line. Positive correlation means y tends to increase as x increases; negative correlation means y tends to decrease. A line of best fit is a straight line drawn through the middle of the points, with about equal numbers of points on each side. It passes through the mean point (x̄, ȳ) and can predict values inside the data range.
examples: A line of best fit passes through (4, 60) and (8, 80). Its gradient is (80 − 60) ÷ (8 − 4) = 5, so the line is y = 5x + 40. For x = 6, y = 5 × 6 + 40 = 70.

contrast.en: Correlation does not prove causation. Two quantities can be strongly correlated because a third factor affects both.
contrast.ru: Корреляция не доказывает причину. Две величины могут сильно коррелировать, если на обе влияет третий фактор.

standardForm.title: Standard Form Converter
standardForm.description: Convert a number to standard form, a × 10ⁿ, where 1 ≤ |a| < 10. The screen rounds values, so the digits shown do not tell you the precision of a measurement.

contrast.en: A calculator writes 5.4 × 10⁵ as 5.4E5. The E means 'times 10 to the power', so 5.4E5 is 540,000, not 5.4 × 5.
contrast.ru: Калькулятор записывает 5,4 × 10⁵ как 5,4E5. Буква E означает «× 10 в степени», поэтому 5,4E5 — это 540 000, а не 5,4 × 5.

quadraticExplorer.title: Quadratic Explorer
quadraticExplorer.description: Explore y = ax² + bx + c: for a ≠ 0 the graph is a parabola; for a = 0 it is linear or constant. The viewing window may hide some roots.

contrast.en: A root is an input value; an intercept is a point. At a repeated root the parabola touches the x-axis without crossing it.
contrast.ru: Корень — значение аргумента, а точка пересечения имеет две координаты. При двойном корне парабола касается оси x, не пересекая её.

sequenceGenerator.title: Sequence Generator
sequenceGenerator.description: Generate the terms numbered n = 1, 2, …: add d for an arithmetic sequence, or multiply by r for a geometric one. Dots show separate terms.

review.englishTerm: Arithmetic and geometric sequences and the nth term
review.russianTerm: Арифметическая и геометрическая прогрессии и формула n-го члена

contrast.en: Arithmetic sequences add a fixed difference d; geometric sequences multiply by a fixed ratio r. If u₁ > 0 and r > 1, the terms grow; if u₁ > 0 and 0 < r < 1, they decrease. A negative r makes the signs alternate.
contrast.ru: В арифметической прогрессии к каждому члену прибавляют разность d, в геометрической — умножают на знаменатель r. Если u₁ > 0 и r > 1, члены растут; если u₁ > 0 и 0 < r < 1, убывают. При отрицательном r знаки членов чередуются.

sequenceGenerator.alt: Separate dots at positive integer values of n. The full list of terms is printed above.

sectorSegment.title: Sector and Segment Calculator
sectorSegment.description: Blue shows the sector bounded by radii; orange shows the segment bounded by chord and arc. Angles above 180° select the major arc and major segment.

contrast.en: A sector and a segment can share an arc, but their straight boundaries differ. The 'sector minus triangle' method works only for minor segments.
contrast.ru: У сектора и сегмента может быть общая дуга, но разные прямолинейные границы. Способ «сектор минус треугольник» подходит только для меньшего сегмента.

model.en: The same formula works for a major segment: ½r²(θ − sin θ), with θ in radians. For π < θ < 2π, sin θ is negative, so the triangle is added, not subtracted.
model.ru: Та же формула подходит и для большого сегмента: ½r²(θ − sin θ), где θ в радианах. При π < θ < 2π синус отрицательный, поэтому треугольник прибавляется, а не вычитается.

sectorSegment.alt: Circle of radius {{radius}} cm. The {{angle}}° arc bounds a blue sector with two radii and an orange segment with a chord.

boxPlot.title: Box Plot Builder
boxPlot.description: Build a modified box plot from a dataset. Quartiles are the medians of the two halves of the data; leave out the middle value when the number of values is odd. Whiskers end at the most extreme values within 1.5·IQR of the quartiles.

contrast.en: A basic five-number box plot uses min/max whiskers. Do not mix that convention with modified whiskers. A flagged outlier is not automatically an error.
contrast.ru: У простой диаграммы размаха по пяти числам усы идут до минимума и максимума. Не смешивай это соглашение с модифицированными усами. Отмеченный выброс не обязательно ошибка.

model.en: Here quartiles are medians of the lower and upper halves, excluding the overall median when n is odd. Software can use other conventions.
model.ru: Здесь квартили — медианы нижней и верхней половин; общая медиана при нечётном n исключается. Программы могут использовать другие соглашения.

boxPlot.input: Dataset: separate numbers with spaces, commas or semicolons; use a decimal point.
boxPlot.alt: Box plot: Q1 {{q1}}, median {{median}}, Q3 {{q3}}; whiskers at {{lower}} and {{upper}}. Outliers are separate dots.

surdSimplifier.title: Surd Simplifier
surdSimplifier.description: Simplify √n for integers 1≤n≤1000. A perfect-square input produces a rational result; not every radical is a surd. A surd is an irrational root.

contrast.en: Keep the surd form for an exact answer. √12 = 2√3 is exact, but 2√3 ≈ 3.46 is only a rounded value.
contrast.ru: Для точного ответа оставляй корень. √12 = 2√3 — точное значение, а 2√3 ≈ 3,46 — только округлённое значение.

transformations.title: Function Transformations
transformations.description: Transform a graph by y=a·f(x−h)+k. Sine uses radians; reciprocal curves have gaps at excluded inputs, and a=0 keeps the original domain.

contrast.en: f(2x) halves horizontal distances: its horizontal scale factor is 1/2. Scaling and translation generally depend on their order.
contrast.ru: f(2x) уменьшает горизонтальные расстояния вдвое: коэффициент по горизонтали равен 1/2. Результат масштабирования и переноса обычно зависит от их порядка.

transformations.legend: Dashed: original function. Solid: transformed. Values are sampled; the drawing is not a proof.

rightTriangle.title: Right-Angled Triangle Trainer
rightTriangle.description: Change the positive leg lengths of a right triangle. θ is at the left vertex: the horizontal leg is adjacent to θ and the vertical leg is opposite it.

contrast.en: sin⁻¹ denotes arcsin on a calculator, not 1/sin. This triangle definition uses 0° < θ < 90°; unit-circle definitions extend the functions.
contrast.ru: На калькуляторе кнопка sin⁻¹ означает арксинус (arcsin), а не 1/sin. Определение через прямоугольный треугольник работает для углов 0° < θ < 90°. Через единичную окружность функции распространяются на другие углы.

numberSetsVenn.title: Number Sets — Venn Diagram
numberSetsVenn.description: Classify exact integers, fractions, finite decimals, π, e and integer multiples of √n (0≤n≤1,000,000). Here ℕ starts at 1; other expressions are not supported.
numberSetsVenn.irrational: Irrational: belongs to ℝ but not to ℚ.
numberSetsVenn.properFraction: A non-integer rational number: belongs to ℚ and ℝ.
numberSetsVenn.positiveWhole: A positive whole number — belongs to all four sets.
numberSetsVenn.integer: An integer (including 0 and negative numbers) — ℤ, ℚ, ℝ.
numberSetsVenn.finiteDecimal: A finite decimal — rational (ℚ) and real (ℝ).

contrast.en: Nested circles: a number inside the ℕ circle is also inside the ℤ, ℚ and ℝ circles. 3 belongs to all four sets, but −3 is not in ℕ.
contrast.ru: Вложенные круги: число внутри круга ℕ находится также внутри кругов ℤ, ℚ и ℝ. Число 3 входит во все четыре множества, а −3 в ℕ не входит.

numberSetsVenn.alt: Nested number sets: ℕ inside ℤ inside ℚ inside ℝ. Membership is also listed in the adjacent text.

bearingsCompass.title: Bearings Compass
bearingsCompass.description: A flat-map bearing is measured clockwise from north at the origin. East offset=d sin θ; north offset=d cos θ.

contrast.en: The bearing of B from A starts at A. The reverse bearing is (θ+180°) modulo 360°, assuming parallel north directions.
contrast.ru: Азимут точки B из точки A отсчитывают от направления на север в точке A. Обратный азимут равен (θ + 180°) по модулю 360°, если направления севера в A и B параллельны.

cumulativeFreq.title: Cumulative Frequency Curve
cumulativeFreq.description: Enter the frequency of each class. Percentiles are estimated by straight-line interpolation, assuming values are evenly spread within each class; an empty dataset has no percentile.

contrast.en: The graph need not be S-shaped. Grouped percentiles are estimates, and flat sections have no observations; do not divide by a zero frequency.
contrast.ru: График не обязан быть S-образным. Перцентили по сгруппированным данным — это оценки. Горизонтальные участки означают, что в интервале нет наблюдений, поэтому делить на нулевую частоту нельзя.

circleTheorems.title: Circle Theorems Playground
circleTheorems.description: Explore valid Euclidean constructions of the circle theorems: inscribed angle, angle in a semicircle, cyclic quadrilateral and intersecting chords.
circleTheorems.ruleCentre: A central angle on the same arc is twice the inscribed angle; C is not on that arc.
circleTheorems.ruleSemicircle: If AB is a diameter and C is any other point on the circle, then ∠ACB = 90°.
circleTheorems.ruleCyclic: Opposite angles in a cyclic quadrilateral sum to 180°.
circleTheorems.ruleChords: When two chords intersect, the products of their segments are equal: AP × PB = CP × PD.

contrast.en: Use the central angle only for the arc that C does not lie on. If C moves to the other arc, the inscribed angle is no longer half of the smaller central angle.
contrast.ru: Бери центральный угол только для той дуги, на которой не лежит точка C. Если C переходит на другую дугу, вписанный угол больше не равен половине меньшего центрального угла.
